summary.en: US equity futures were mixed pre-bell Tuesday, with Nasdaq-100 futures up 0.23% and Dow futures down 0.82%, as traders awaited Nvidia's fiscal Q3 report due after the close. The Trump administration is reportedly moving to block imports of Chinese data center equipment on national security grounds, while Home Depot and Disney both posted higher adjusted earnings. Oil futures rose (Brent +1.41% at $93.65, WTI +1.59% at $86.89) and the 10-year Treasury yield ticked up 2 basis points to 5.141%, providing a mild headwind to the attempted equity repair.
summary.zh: 周二盘前美股期货涨跌互现，纳指100期货涨0.23%，道指期货跌0.82%，市场等待英伟达盘后发布第三季度财报。据报道，特朗普政府正以国家安全为由推进阻止中国数据中心设备进口的计划，家得宝和迪士尼均报告调整后盈利增长。原油期货走高（布伦特涨1.41%至$93.65，WTI涨1.59%至$86.89），10年期美债收益率上行2个基点至5.141%，对股市修复构成轻微逆风。

title.en: US futures mixed pre-bell; Trump admin to block Chinese data center equipment imports; HD and DIS post higher adjusted earnings
title.zh: 美股期货盘前涨跌互现；特朗普政府拟阻止中国数据中心设备进口；家得宝和迪士尼调整后盈利增长

impact.en: The Chinese equipment import restriction, if finalized, could reshape supply chains for AI data center buildout and add cost pressure on US hyperscalers. The mixed futures and rising oil suggest a cautious tone into Nvidia's after-close report.
impact.zh: 若中国设备进口限制最终落地，可能重塑AI数据中心建设的供应链格局，并增加美国超大规模云厂商的成本压力。期货涨跌互现叠加油价走高，显示市场在英伟达盘后财报前保持谨慎。

title.en: Nvidia fiscal Q3 report after close seen as pivotal test for AI semiconductor trade; Anthropic IPO expected Thursday
title.zh: 英伟达盘后发布第三季度财报被视为AI半导体交易的关键考验；Anthropic预计周四上市

impact.en: Nvidia's report and interim CEO Colette Kress's commentary on AI capex sustainability will be a key signal for whether the semiconductor sector is bottoming. A weak guide or cautious tone could extend the correction, while a confident outlook may trigger a relief bounce in AI-linked names.

note.en: Monday's broad selloff (Nasdaq -2.44%, SOXX -5.45%) left Tuesday's premarket futures in a tentative, uneven repair: NQ up 0.23% while ES down 0.2% and YM down 0.82%, suggesting a tech-led bounce rather than broad risk-on. The 10-year yield at 5.141% (+2 bp) and Brent at $93.65 (+1.41%) provide a mild cost headwind; the dollar is flat at 103.71, neither amplifying nor offsetting the move. I lean toward viewing the NQ gain as an attempted repair after a sharp prior-session decline, not a confirmed reversal, particularly with the reported push to block Chinese data-center equipment imports weighing on the semi complex. Watchpoint: if NQ holds its positive bias into the first thirty minutes of the cash session and ES also turns positive, the repair is broadening; if NQ fades back below the prior close while the 10-year yield drifts higher, the bounce likely stalls.
note.zh: 周一的广泛抛售（纳指-2.44%、SOXX-5.45%）使周二盘前期货呈现试探性、不均衡的修复：NQ涨0.23%而ES跌0.2%、YM跌0.82%，暗示科技股领涨的反弹而非全面风险偏好回升。10年期美债收益率升至5.141%（+2bp）、布伦特原油涨至$93.65（+1.41%），构成温和的成本逆风；美元持平于103.71，既未放大也未抵消这一走势。我倾向于将NQ的上涨视为一次修复尝试而非趋势反转，尤其是在据报道政府正推进阻止中国数据中心设备进口、对半导体板块形成压力的背景下。观察要点：若NQ在开盘前30分钟内维持正偏且ES也转为正，则修复在扩散；若NQ回落到前收下方而10年期收益率继续上行，则反弹大概率停滞。
